mapper.insert: INSERT INTO upload_asset (id, user_id, template_id, original_filename, storage_key, mime_type, size_bytes) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{templateId}, #{originalFilename}, #{storageKey}, #{mimeType}, #{sizeBytes})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, template_id, original_filename, storage_key, mime_type, size_bytes, created_at FROM upload_asset WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
